metadata.purpose: Track current-public-source freshness without converting an unverified publication gap into a zero or an assertion that no source exists.

status_semantics.verified_current: An authoritative public source covering the latest currently applicable period was verified and is represented in production.
status_semantics.verified_new_source: A newer authoritative public source was verified but is not yet represented in production.
status_semantics.not_yet_verified: Targeted research did not verify the targeted newer source. This is not proof that the source does not exist, is late, or will not be published.
status_semantics.current_source_research: The domain source discovery itself was refreshed on the research date; publication/approval timing still governs record availability.

automation_scope.note: The weekly refresh workflow currently re-runs compensation and budget ingestion only. A successful run with no committed diff does not establish freshness for the other domains.
